additional_info.subject: SCB log regarding to phase P02 failure
ID0390636-DC/Si-D/NO-[FJ9wqF]- DC2 "P02_PARAMETER_DISCOVERY" --> "P00_UNKNOWN" CRM:00315002079
additional_info.body:
Dear Markus,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S1 170003263
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
FJ9wqF
Problem Description
: Charging stops in Parameter_Discovery
Troubleshooting
:
As we already aligned, we don't see a PilotState change from B to C:
This is what a good session looks like:
From these logs alone I cannot say if it's the cables or the EcoGs. I would recommend going to site and do the checks regarding the CP and PP voltage.
When we connect the car if we are stuck in 9V from the cable, the problem should be the cable or contacts. If we can see the 6V PilotState coming from the cable, we need to see downstream if there is a problem with any connector and if this value is reaching the EcoG. If there is 6V at the input of EcoG, then it's possible that there is an error with it.
My suggestion would be to take only 1 spare CCS cable and 1 set of KF11, KF12 and KF14. There are connections from CP to KF11 and KF14 and for second outlet to KF12 and KF14.
Since the problem is in both outlets it might be just the KF14, let's hope so. Fingers crossed.
I will move this to the RC-NO queue, just reach out to me in case you need support.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0390636
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
